Strategy: Refine the distribution family by targeting the mean residual: score bins by closeness to the mean of the feasible residuals, with a bonus for an exact fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest bin lies far from the mean while another bin sits near it, so a typical bin wins. This may balance load across bins, but the mean can be poor when residuals split into tight and loose clusters.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    mean = sum(bins) / len(bins)
    return [(10000 if r == item else 0) - abs(r - mean) for r in bins]
```
